name: Використання зв’язок
description:
A pin is a real power move! We have seen it before and you will do some more pinning is this lesson. Being a real pin master can help you beat strong opponents.

So let's recap: what is a pin?
A pin is an attack on a piece that is unable to move away. Should it move to safety, a stronger piece behind it gets into trouble.

How do you spot a pin? Look for pieces (or a piece and a mating square) on the same file, rank or diagonal. Found them? Move your piece to that file, rank or diagonal as well and (safely!) attack the piece in front.


What do you have to do?

Pin one of your opponent’s pieces and win points.
